requirements: R1: save_cache(path, entries) writes the JSON object {"version": 2, "entries": entries}; load_cache(path) returns the entries of a version-2 file and {} for a missing, unreadable, or older-format file.
R2: MAX_ATTEMPTS becomes 5, and should_retry(attempts_made) returns True exactly when attempts_made < MAX_ATTEMPTS, so a sync is attempted at most MAX_ATTEMPTS times in total.
R3: clear_cache(user, path) deletes the cache file only when user.is_admin is True; for any other user it raises PermissionError and leaves the file in place.
risks: cache file format (persisted state): low — the cache is local and regenerable; an unreadable or old-format file only causes a cache miss
retry boundary: low — an off-by-one costs at most one background attempt
clear_cache authorization and signature change: medium — unauthorized clearing only forces a cache rebuild
invariants: I1: no non-admin principal can delete the cache file, and the denial does not fail open
preserved_behaviors: P1: load_cache never raises for a missing or unreadable file; it returns {}
P2: a save_cache/load_cache round trip preserves the entries
